resources.name: jakub
resources.primary_claim: Improves interface review quality and gives concrete fixes without redesigning for novelty.
resources.baseline: general agent without the jakub specialist

evals.task: Review a dense admin dashboard for hierarchy, layout, typography, color, accessibility and component consistency.
Plan a database migration with no interface work.
must_not_observe: jakub selected without a UI reason

resources.name: emi
resources.primary_claim: Improves motion and interaction decisions while exercising restraint.
resources.baseline: general agent without the emi specialist

evals.task: Review a modal, toast, command palette and route transition for motion quality and interaction feel.
must_observe: motion tied to state, hierarchy or causality
reusable motion or interaction rule when justified

evals.task: Model entities and permissions for an admin domain.
must_not_observe: emi selected without an interaction or motion reason

resources.name: cd
resources.primary_claim: Selects the right specialist, uses only necessary stages, and promotes only proven reusable learning.
resources.baseline: general agent without Compound Design orchestration

evals.task: Audit a web admin screen whose main problem is visual hierarchy and accessibility.
must_observe: routes interface craft to jakub or loads equivalent source material
does not force unrelated Compound Design stages

evals.task: The interface works but route transitions and modal interactions feel wrong. Improve the experience.
must_observe: routes motion or interaction work to emi or equivalent source material

evals.task: Map entities, routes, roles, permissions, states and edge cases for an admin users module.
must_observe: produces a coherent screen or flow relationship model

evals.task: Change one label from Members to Users.
A feature is complete. Decide what should become reusable Compound Design or Supernova material.
must_observe: requires evidence of usefulness and generalizability
proposes candidates rather than silently publishing

run_policy.promotion_rule: Critical failures block approval regardless of average score. CD_APPROVED is limited to the evaluated scope.
